summary: The diff adds a TanStack Router-based multi-page frontend with public routes and an /admin area guarded by Internet Identity + an isAdmin check, plus a backend Motoko actor that includes authorization and blob storage mixins and implements several admin-managed entities (social links, portfolio items, user profiles). However, multiple BuildRequest requirements cannot be confirmed from the provided diff summary (notably full marketing-page copy/SEO, Stripe checkout/order recording, complete admin CRUD scope, contact request persistence, coupons full lifecycle, loyalty rules/ledger, giveaway wheel/spin/winner persistence, and static generated assets being committed), largely due to truncation/omitted files and missing evidence in the shown snippets.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement the specified user-facing marketing page copy/content (headline/subheadline/CTAs/quotes; About vision/mission/emission; Services categories + KY guidance; Contact fields + response-time guidance; Hours & Policies sections including anti-discrimination and required quote).
missing_requirements.reason: Routes/pages are defined, but the diff summary does not show the actual page implementations/content for Home/About/Services/Contact/Hours & Policies, so required copy/sections/fields cannot be verified.
evidence: frontend/src/App.tsx (routes present but page components truncated/not shown)

evidence: frontend/src/App.tsx (HomePage referenced but HomePage not shown)

frontend/src/components/PageHeaderBanner.tsx (renders an H1 but does not prove one-per-page or per-route meta)

missing_requirements.requirement: Restrict admin access to a single allowlisted Internet Identity principal stored in backend settings; backend-enforced admin-only mutations; mechanism to set admin principal.

evidence: backend/main.mo (shows AccessControl/MixinAuthorization init but does not show admin principal setting/initialization in provided snippet)

backend/main.mo (portfolio and social links shown; rest truncated)
